disorder-name.detail: Schizophrenia; clinical cohort comprising discovery (HCP-EP, n=140) and validation (ASRB, n=335) datasets. Supplementary tables label all cases as 'SZ'.

dataset-of-origin.detail: Discovery cohort cases (n=140) from Human Connectome Project for Early Psychosis (HCP-EP); validation cohort cases (n=335) from Australian Schizophrenia Research Bank (ASRB). HCP-YA provided controls only.
dataset-of-origin.supporting_text: "This study comprised a total of 1849 participants drawn from three independent datasets: (1) the Human Connectome Project-Young Adult Sample [15]; (2) the Human Connectome Project for Early Psychosis (HCPpsychosis) [16]; and (3) the Australian Schizophrenia Research Bank (ASRB) [17]."

age.detail: Weighted mean and pooled SD across two datasets: HCP-EP SZ (n=140, mean=22.78, SD=3.83) and ASRB SZ (n=335, mean=39.70, SD=10.81). Weighted mean = (140×22.78 + 335×39.70)/475 = 34.71; pooled SD = sqrt(((139×3.83² + 334×10.81²)/473)) = 9.32. Min/max not reported.

sex.detail: Combined across two datasets: HCP-EP SZ 48 females + ASRB SZ 100 females = 148 females; males estimated by subtraction (140−48=92; 335−100=235; total 327). Male counts estimated from total N minus reported female N.
